answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a deposit held in escrow at the work wharf; it unlocks only as the agent builds a steady fingerprint: distinct counterparties and steady cadence. A lantern check compares fingerprints; a mismatch locks the bond 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits plus proving time, while honest work flows like a river: one agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
